title: Jesus Grows Up
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: After their visit to the temple, Mary and Joseph took Jesus home to Nazareth. There Jesus grew up.
Joseph made things from wood, and Jesus learned to be a carpenter too. He helped His family, the way you help yours.
Jesus grew strong. He grew wise, learning more and more of what is true and good. And Heavenly Father’s love was with Him.
p2: Jesus obeyed Mary and Joseph. He grew taller, and He grew wiser. Heavenly Father loved Him, and the people who knew Him loved Him too.
You are growing too, a little more every day. Tonight, think of one way you helped your family today. Heavenly Father’s love is with you while you grow.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
